depth_sweep.svg: Small multiples of accuracy against depth for 16 stateful tasks (rows) on Qwen3.5-9B, Llama-3.3-70B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash (columns), with chain of thought in blue and without in red; the shaded band between them is the CoT gain, which is wide for many tasks, narrow for several, and absent for multiplication.
dumbbell.svg: Dumbbell chart of accuracy with chain of thought, published trace format versus a rewritten variant, for five tasks on Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash; the rewrite lifts Tower of Hanoi, cellular automaton, S5 composition, random lookup table and 3SUM on the 9B model from 0.5 or below to 0.9 or above.
goldko.svg: Line chart of Qwen3.5-9B accuracy when the gold trace is given through step k and the answer is then forced, for ten tasks: nearly every curve stays near its no-CoT floor until the last step, then jumps to high accuracy when the model writes its own full trace, with program trace the exception that reaches 1.0 at k = d-1.
propagation.svg: Dot plot of mistake propagation for ten tasks on Qwen3.5-9B: random lookup table and nested arithmetic carry a corrupted step through to the answer almost always, Tower of Hanoi much less because the model detects the corruption, and 3SUM is negative because its clean continuation already fails.
tokens.svg: Dot plot of chain-of-thought tokens per step for each task's surviving format, on a log scale from 3 to 1000, for 14 tasks, comparing Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash spend with the gold trace's cost; most tasks cost 10 to 100 tokens per step, while cellular automaton and 3SUM run to several hundred.
